topics.name: Multimodal creativity assessment
topics.summary: Human judgments of originality and aesthetic quality are compared with multimodal model scores and critiques. The evidence combines zero-shot ratings, open-ended explanations, and image-specificity analysis, showing that fluent commentary does not always reflect grounded visual understanding.

topics.name: Language-model reasoning and grounded generation
topics.summary: These studies improve language and vision-language reasoning through discrete latent compression, retrieval adaptation, outcome-based SQL checks, visual grounding, and strategy-aware training. They examine both the efficiency of intermediate computation and whether generated reasoning remains tied to task evidence.

topics.name: Language-model reliability and evaluation
topics.summary: Calibration, hallucination tests, cross-view consistency, clinical reasoning graphs, judge panels, and certification benchmarks expose gaps between fluent outputs and dependable behavior. The recurring lesson is that reliability requires task-specific evidence and repeated measurement rather than a single accuracy score.

topics.name: Agent planning and tool use
topics.summary: Agentic workflows coordinate planning, tool selection, shared state, and iterative execution across research, coding, spreadsheets, traffic control, and engineering design. The methods emphasize dynamic skill discovery, outcome-based credit, workload measurement, and governance of concurrent actions.

topics.name: Multi-agent coordination and governance
topics.summary: Multi-agent systems are studied through decentralized reinforcement learning, communication routing, deliberation, regulatory control, and specification-driven validation. Across social, legal, therapeutic, and industrial settings, explicit roles and auditable interaction protocols are used to improve coordination and safety.

topics.name: Persistent agent memory and personalization
topics.summary: Long-lived agents organize experiences, concepts, procedures, and user signals into retrievable state. The studies cover embodied manipulation, conversation, financial advising, on-device operation, personalization audits, and self-improvement, while measuring leakage, interference, and inflated self-assessment.

topics.name: Agent evaluation and verification
topics.summary: Agent benchmarks assess fact attribution, evaluator drift, medical search, portfolio analysis, and rubric checking with process signals and independent verification. Their recurring finding is that self-reported quality and surface preference can diverge from grounded task success and cost-effective behavior.

topics.name: Agentic applications and skill learning
topics.summary: Application-focused agents learn reusable skills, beliefs, context policies, and task-specific behaviors for scientific discovery, education, engineering, preference construction, and embodied systems. Distillation, self-generated credit, resource-aware search, and semantic interfaces support transfer across tasks and users.

topics.name: Retrieval-augmented generation and evidence search
topics.summary: Retrieval pipelines are improved with graph expansion, calibrated context budgets, permutation-invariant structured records, regime-specific evidence arbitration, and efficient attention. Applications include question answering, GUI grounding, recommendation, medical mapping, model discovery, and evidence-aware tool use.

topics.name: LLM alignment and post-training
topics.summary: Post-training methods combine preference optimization, adaptive data selection, multi-teacher distillation, online imitation, reward decomposition, and intermediate representations. Across language, multimodal generation, dialogue, and molecular applications, they seek better capability transfer while limiting reward distortion and instability.

topics.name: Efficient language-model training and inference
topics.summary: Efficiency work reduces compute through adaptive distillation, speculative decoding, early exits, compression, dynamic sparsity, learned state management, and low-cost optimization. The studies span text generation, 3D vision, federated learning, and large language models, balancing speed, memory, and retained quality.

topics.name: AI safety, privacy, and adversarial robustness
topics.summary: The papers address privacy accounting, poisoning, watermark forgery, harmful supervision, prompt injection, adversarial perception, malware, and secure IoT or semantic communication. Defenses combine formal analysis, representation changes, runtime monitoring, and deployment-specific risk measures.

topics.name: Interpretability and mechanistic machine learning
topics.summary: Interpretability is pursued with attribution, local fidelity, concept bottlenecks, structured image representations, entropy measures, and analyses of training or communication dynamics. The applications range from finance and cybersecurity to physiological sensing and generative media, linking explanations to model behavior.

topics.name: Multimodal representation learning
topics.summary: Visual, linguistic, biological, and action signals are aligned with sparse features, cross-modal distillation, state-aware tokenization, continual adaptation, and expert routing. The datasets and applications cover charts, histopathology, cardiovascular screening, dance, education, and embodied action.

topics.name: Robust visual perception and recognition
topics.summary: Recognition systems use geometric normalization, cross-view correspondence, latent prompts, feature refinement, compression-aware processing, and multimodal fusion to handle viewpoint, modality, and appearance changes. The applications include medical images, traffic, faces, hands, surveillance, and adverse-weather detection.

topics.name: Anomaly detection and model robustness
topics.summary: Anomaly and robustness studies build support-conditioned boundaries, local-flatness scores, semantic-topology checks, active adaptation, and adversarial diagnostics. They cover visual data, graphs, code leakage, optical networks, malware, and structured classification under unfamiliar or manipulated inputs.

topics.name: Robust language, speech, and structured prediction
topics.summary: Language and speech systems are tested under noisy text, multilingual variation, audio manipulation, temporal interaction, and formal or geometric constraints. The studies combine transformer adaptation, layer selection, temporal modeling, graph structure, and theoretical analyses of neural decision boundaries.

topics.name: Medical imaging and clinical segmentation
topics.summary: Medical studies use boundary-aware losses, RECIST guidance, uncertainty estimation, graph prototypes, deformation models, and concept bottlenecks for diagnosis, segmentation, and longitudinal assessment. Data span breast, prostate, brain, cardiac, and whole-slide imaging, with emphasis on specificity and deployment reliability.

topics.name: 3D reconstruction and geometric scene modeling
topics.summary: Geometric models combine Gaussian primitives, scene graphs, spherical or stereo cameras, canonical object frames, occupancy tracking, and feed-forward rendering. The applications include indoor panoramas, urban simulation, avatars, articulated objects, digital twins, LiDAR mapping, and long-range outdoor SLAM.

topics.name: Speech and audio generation and analysis
topics.summary: Audio research covers speaker privacy, dysarthric recognition, self-supervised representations, deepfake detection, synchronized facial animation, singing edits, and speech-to-speech generation. Common concerns are low latency, temporal alignment, domain transfer, and preserving useful linguistic content.

topics.name: Robot manipulation and morphology-aware learning
topics.summary: Robotic systems learn compliant control, grasping, tactile policies, whole-body retargeting, contact-rich skills, and morphology transfer. Experiments span soft arms, quadrupeds, additive manufacturing, endovascular tools, and real-to-sim settings, with closed-loop feedback used to improve execution.

topics.name: Autonomous driving and traffic planning
topics.summary: Driving studies combine platoon stability, world models, occupancy prediction, visual-dependence audits, interaction-aware decisions, and rollout-based policy improvement. The recurring goal is safer planning under changing traffic conditions, imperfect visual evidence, and accumulated deployment experience.

topics.name: Aerial robotics and navigation
topics.summary: UAV systems address pose, metric depth, formation control, GNSS-denied search, viewpoint planning, tether-aware exploration, wind estimation, and runtime edge orchestration. Their evaluations emphasize energy, obstacle safety, uncertainty, and operation in partially observed environments.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning and adaptive control
topics.summary: These papers improve value propagation, uncertainty-aware exploration, adversarial robustness, adaptive training, world-model control, sensor-efficient transfer, and constrained neural controllers. Benchmarks span games, visual control, energy systems, quantum circuits, and physical dynamics.

topics.name: Graph learning and relational data
topics.summary: Graph methods combine self-supervised community discovery, graph-LLM fusion, relation completion, test-time adaptation, generative attack analysis, and curvature-aware diffusion. The recurring applications involve brain networks, knowledge graphs, text-attributed nodes, and heterogeneous graph classification.

topics.name: Generative diffusion and flow models
topics.summary: Diffusion, flow matching, normalizing flows, and transport methods are applied to image synthesis, microscopy restoration, density morphing, orbital inference, weather, and statistical physics. The studies emphasize controllable sampling, preservation of prior structure, scalable estimation, and reward or physics guidance.

topics.name: Language models and multilingual NLP
topics.summary: The studies build multilingual privacy-dialogue data and probe what transformer representations retain when trained on structurally unusual languages. They focus on data construction, transfer behavior, and the limits of language-model generalization across linguistic conditions.

topics.name: Recommendation and ranking
topics.summary: Recommendation research models partial-order preferences, sequential user state, and competing objectives in marketplace decisions. The methods combine ranking losses, real-time personalization, and constrained experiments to improve relevance while accounting for business-side tradeoffs.

topics.name: Optimization and operations research
topics.summary: Optimization methods cover evolutionary search, Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization, bilevel algorithm design, geometric feedback, gradient smoothing, and web-scale data selection. Across neural architecture, SLAM, combinatorial, and pretraining problems, the work targets scalable search with better stability and resource use.

topics.name: Causal inference and uncertainty quantification
topics.summary: Causal and statistical methods address confounding, temporal dependence, feature-manifold registration, and ambiguous decisions. Doubly robust estimation, conformal intervals, causal metric learning, and uncertainty-aware generation provide safeguards when observations or interventions are incomplete.

topics.name: Scientific machine learning and PDEs
topics.summary: Physical constraints and learned surrogates are combined for neural rendering and governing-equation discovery. The methods use differentiable physics, multi-source observations, and scalable optimization to recover structure while improving prediction beyond purely data-driven fits.

topics.name: Quantum machine learning
topics.summary: Quantum-oriented learning uses variational circuits, simulated quantum machines, and open-system models to study compact visual control and physical dynamics. The recurring methods rely on hybrid classical-quantum training, structural recovery, and resource-aware parameterization.

topics.name: Biology and protein modeling
topics.summary: Biological machine learning combines single-cell perturbation modeling, molecular representations, uncertainty estimates, and interpretable immune-receptor prediction. The applications span drug response, molecular properties, antibody-related ranking, and sequence-structure relationships under sparse experimental supervision.

topics.name: Clinical AI and public health
topics.summary: Clinical and public-health systems address coronary risk, trial dosing errors, epidemic intervention, clinician-patient simulation, and retrieval limits in medical assistants. The work combines domain-specific embeddings, structured dialogue, network optimization, and human-centered evaluation.

topics.name: Education and human-AI interaction
topics.summary: Educational systems use scrutable interfaces, preference-based tutoring control, and human creativity benchmarks to study how people interact with generative models. The shared emphasis is keeping users involved in evaluation, steering, and interpretation rather than optimizing automated outputs alone.

topics.name: Social science and AI governance
topics.summary: These studies examine culture-aware generation, linguistic bias, legal uncertainty, community-note revision, companion-bot relationships, emotional expression, and AI-assisted interviewing. They combine behavioral data, co-design, controlled embeddings, and social analysis to evaluate consequences beyond model accuracy.

topics.name: Datasets and empirical benchmarks
topics.summary: New datasets and benchmarks measure mathematical retrieval, visual reasoning, atomistic training storage, tabular integration, video editing, medical cytology, enterprise security, and scientific knowledge transfer. They expose domain shift, distractor effects, annotation limits, and the difference between public benchmark performance and deployment behavior.

topics.name: Machine-learning systems and hardware
topics.summary: Systems work studies CUDA parallelization and asynchronous pipeline training for neural networks. Both focus on reducing execution or communication overhead while preserving throughput and convergence at scale.

topics.name: Remote sensing and geospatial AI
topics.summary: Geospatial models combine foundation-model transfer, cross-sensor alignment, uncertainty-aware registration, and generative despeckling for agricultural and flood-mapping tasks. The studies emphasize geographic shift, optical-radar mismatch, and reliable dense predictions from satellite data.

topics.name: Signal processing and embodied sensing
topics.summary: The papers use EEG and force sensing to infer human expertise or adapt visuomotor policies. Their methods combine learned temporal features with continual multimodal adaptation, addressing noisy physiological signals and changing contact dynamics.

topics.name: Theoretical machine learning
topics.summary: Theory papers analyze latent manifolds, memorization, certified unlearning, reasoning limits, grokking, shortcut features, continual-learning convergence, stability, and tensor completion. Their common tools include random-matrix, stochastic-geometric, optimization, and information-theoretic analysis.

topics.name: Scientific machine learning and numerical methods
topics.summary: Physics-augmented networks, Gibbs-based learning, detector stability, sliced-Wasserstein estimation, and regularized linear solves address scientific and computational bottlenecks. The recurring strategy is to combine structural assumptions with parallelizable or better-conditioned numerical procedures.

topics.name: Embodied navigation and world models
topics.summary: Navigation agents predict spatial state, future actions, routines, or temporal constraints before moving through environments. The work spans image-goal flight, language navigation, humanoid settings, and continuous control, using memory, occupancy, and action-conditioned world models to improve foresight.

topics.name: LLM safety and reliability controls
topics.summary: Reliability controls for language models include context-rot diagnosis, instruction-hierarchy decoding, clinical reasoning evaluation, belief-trajectory testing, and diffusion-language hallucination monitoring. These methods use uncertainty, divergence, structured traces, and multi-step evidence to reduce unsupported or conflicting behavior.

topics.name: Scientometrics and technology evolution
topics.summary: Publication-scale analyses trace novelty, researcher topics, algorithm mentions, journal independence, entity extraction, and critical information-retrieval practice. Network structure, longitudinal language analysis, and structured metadata are used to study how research communities and technical methods evolve.

topics.name: Tabular, causal, and structured prediction
topics.summary: Structured-data methods study table parsing, tabular foundation models, causal decision formulations, human-response estimation, and generalization beyond IID splits. Encoders, Bayesian or causal structure, and integrated benchmarks reveal where broad models help and where domain-specific procedures remain necessary.

topics.name: Robot learning and adaptive control
topics.summary: Robot policies improve through contact-centric sim-to-real transfer, confidence-driven test-time updates, real-platform VLA studies, multi-robot coordination, and energy-aware current control. Demonstrations, synthetic interaction, and closed-loop feedback provide supervision when rewards or hardware trials are limited.

topics.name: Visual tracking and interactive segmentation
topics.summary: Tracking and segmentation methods add nonlinear state dynamics, cylindrical geometry, point-seed instance cues, degraded-image feature enhancement, and online LiDAR adaptation. They target occlusion, adverse imaging, multi-object association, and changing deployment conditions in video and 3D perception.

topics.name: Weather, epidemiology, and longitudinal forecasting
topics.summary: Continuous-time neural models and probabilistic diffusion methods forecast precipitation, recurrent clinical events, neurodegeneration, glaucoma fields, and outbreak transmission. Uncertain timing, bias correction, rare events, and decision-relevant intervals recur across these forecasting applications.

topics.name: Language-model systems and long-context inference
topics.summary: Long-context systems combine sequence-aware parallelism, hybrid attention, sparse decoding, and cache reuse to lower communication and memory costs. The methods target extended-context training and serving while preserving retrieval quality and reducing unnecessary computation.

topics.name: Generative vision and video synthesis
topics.summary: Generative vision methods use geometric editing, text-latent diffusion, feed-forward video or avatar reconstruction, photomosaics, and cinematic or human-image animation. They focus on preserving structure, following unusual attributes, and producing controllable motion or high-resolution content efficiently.

topics.name: Formal verification and temporal control
topics.summary: Formal methods certify neural properties, physical designs, temporal specifications, and autonomous controllers using interval probabilities, deterministic checks, mixed-integer synthesis, and robustness constraints. The shared aim is to separate learned proposals from explicit safety or satisfaction guarantees.

topics.name: Reinforcement learning under adaptive dynamics
topics.summary: These studies improve value learning, exploration, policy adaptation, and reasoning-model training with confidence signals, hierarchical tactics, imagined data, flow policies, and closed-form reward dynamics. Benchmarks span games, visual control, navigation, and language-model post-training.
